description: This file defines a class 'GlobalConfigSubscriber' which is an event listener/subscriber for Symfony framework's kernel request events. It sets certain configuration flags based on query parameters in HTTP requests, specifically for internationalization and date formatting. It also handles exceptions and logs errors if configuration setting fails.

classes.name: GlobalConfigSubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber class that listens for request events and updates configuration settings based on query parameters.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the KernelEvents::REQUEST event to the 'onRequestEvent' method with priority 0.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request event, extracting query parameters '_i18nEnabled' and '_dateFormattingEnabled' to set corresponding configuration flags.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets a configuration key-value pair, with exception handling and error logging.
